steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Special: ∫1/x dx = ln|x| + C, ∫eˣ dx = eˣ + C

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Trig: ∫sin x dx = -cos x + C, ∫cos x dx = sin x + C, ∫sec^2x dx = tan x + C

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Evaluate ∫₀^2 xsqrt(4 - x^2) dx using substitution u = 4 - x^2 --- Solution: u = 4 - x^2, du = -2x dx -> x dx = -½ du. Limits: x=0->u=4, x=2->u=0. ∫₄⁰ sqrtu (-½)du = ½∫₀⁴ u^½ du = ½[⅔u^⅔]₀⁴ = ⅓(8) = 8/3

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: ∫(3x^2 - 2x + 5)e^{x^3-x^2+5x} dx | ∫x cos x dx (by parts) | ∫₀¹ x/(1+x^2)^2 dx

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of integration with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: Evaluate ∫₀^2 xsqrt(4 - x^2) dx using substitution u = 4 - x^2. Solution: u = 4 - x^2, du = -2x dx -> x dx = -½ du. Limits: x=0->u=4, x=2->u=0. ∫₄⁰ sqrtu (-½)du = ½∫₀⁴ u^½ du = ½[⅔u^⅔]₀⁴ = ⅓(8) = 8/3 Practice (10 min): Students attempt the practice questions independently; circulate and support. Plenary (5 min): Review answers and address misconceptions.
